# Table.Unpivot

```m
Table.Unpivot(table as table, pivotColumns as list, attributeColumn as text, valueColumn as text) as table
```

Translates a set of columns in a table into attribute-value pairs.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/table-unpivot)
